description: Resource Projection base type (extension point). Abstract: each gear derives its own projection types, for example gts.cf.core.approval.projection.v1~cf.procurement._.purchase_order.v1~, and may register projections only for types it owns (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-resource-projection). A projection is the stable, approval-specific presentation of an external resource. The base is deliberately closed ('additionalProperties: false' with no extension field): derived types add identity only, never properties or traits, so no internal resource field can enter the service. Identity is (projection type, resource_tenant_id, resource_id, version); a different version is a different projection (DESIGN cpt-cf-approval-service-entity-projection).

resource_tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the resource. Part of the projection identity.

resource_id.description: Stable resource identifier assigned by the owning gear. ASCII only.

version.description: Resource version, for example a revision number, commit SHA, or content hash. Empty when the gear does not version the resource. An approval of one version never covers another.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown to administrators and approvers. Updated on re-registration.
